paite: Hon enzuite hi un, kei leng Khrist enzuipa ka hih mah bang in.
Huan bangkim a na hon theihgige ziak un leh thukhah ka hon hilh bang a na vom tinten ziak un ka hon phat ahi.
heading: Khristian Biakna A Lukhuh Thu

paite: Himahleh pasal peuhmah lutang Khrist ahi, numei lutang pasal ahi, Khrist lutang Pathian ahi chih na theih uh ka deih hi.
Pasal alu khuh kawm a thum hiam, thu gen hiam peuhmah in, alu aselphou hi.
Himahleh numei alu khuh lou a thum hiam, thu gen hiam peuhmah in alu selphou ahi; metmai toh kibang ahi.
Numei alu khuh lou a a-om ngalleh met vanglak hen. Himahleh, numei a ding a sam met leh metmai azumhuaileh alu khuh hen.
Pasal zaw Pathian batpih leh thupina ahih ziak in alu akhuh ding hilou himhim ahi; numei bel pasal thupina ahi.
Numei a kipan pasal pawt ahi kei a; numei bel pasal a kipan a pawt ahi zaw hi;
numei a dia pasal siam ahi kei a; numei bel pasal a dia siam ahi zaw hi.
Huaiziak in angelte ziak in numei in pasal thuneihna chiamtehna akhuk ding ahi.
Himahleh Toupa thilgeldan ah, pasal lou in numei a-om thei kei a, pasal leng numei lou in a-om thei sam kei hi.
Pasal a kipan a numei pawt ahih bang in, pasal leng numei lak a piang ahi ngal a; himahleh bangkim Pathian a kipan a pawt vek ahi.
Noumau kingaihtuah dih ua, numei in alu khuh lou a Pathian kiang a thum akilawm hiam?
Pasal in samsau aneihleh amah a ding in azumhuai ahi chih na lungtang pianpih un leng ahon theisak kei a hia?
Numei in bel samsau aneihleh amah a ding in thupina ahi zaw; kikhuhna ding a asam piak ahih ziak in.
Himahleh mi kuahiam hiai thu a agenhakleh huchibang paidan himhim i nei kei ua, Pathian saptuam pawlte'n leng anei sam kei uhi.
Himahleh nou hiai thu ka hon hilhna ah ka hon phat thei kei, na hoihsemna ding uh hilou in, na siatsemna ding ua na kikhop nak ziak un.
heading: Toupa Nitak Ankuang Hihnitna / (Mat 26.26-29; Mar 14.22-25; Luk 22.14-20)

paite: Amasapen in saptuamte na kikhop un, na lak uah kilangkhenna a-om chih ka za a; gin leng ka gingta sim hi.
Na lak ua ataktakte alattheihna ding un, na lak ua gintuamna leng a-om sam ding him ahi.
Na hong kikhop ua na nekkhawm uh Toupa nitak an ahi kei hi;
Michih in na nek chiang un noumau nitak an na ne masa zel ngal ua; huchi in mi khat gil akial a, adang in akham hi.

Bangchidan ahia? Nek leh dawnna ding inn na nei kei ua hia? Ahihkeileh Pathian saptuamte musit in, bangmah neiloute na selphou ua hia? Na kiang uah bang ka genta dia? K'on phat dia hia? Hiai lam thu ah ka hon phat thei kei hi.
Ka thu hon hilhsawn Toupa kiang a kipan ka muh ahi, huchi a Toupa Jesu'n matsak a a-om zan a, tanghou alak a,
kipahthu agen khit a abalkhap a, "Hiai ka pumpi nou a dia piak ahi, keimah theihgigena in hiai hih zel un,” achih.
Huchi mah bang a nitak an anek khit a nou leng alak a, "Hiai nou ka sisan a thukhun thak ahi, na dawn teng un keimah theihgigena in hih zel un," achih.
Huai tanghou na nek ua, nou na dawn teng un ahong pai nawn masiah, Toupa sihna na puangzak uhi.
Huaiziak in kuapeuh kilawmloutak a tanghou ne hiam, Toupa nou dawn hiam in Toupa pumpi leh sisan tung ah siam louh atang ding hi.
Huchi in michih amah ki-enchian zaw hen, huchibang in tanghou ne in nou dawn hen.
Ane leh dawn in Toupa pumpi ngenteltak a angaihtuah keileh amah tung a vaihawmna ding in ane in adawn hi.
Hiai ziak in na lak ua mi tampi na hat kei ua, na zawngkhal ua, tampi'n na sihloh uhi.
Himahleh ngenteltak in eimah kingaihtuah zel lehang, vai hawmsak a om nak lou ding i hi uhi.
Himahleh vai hawmsak a i om in leng khovel toh siam louh tang a i omlouhna ding in Toupa taihilh in i om zel ahi.
Huaiziak in ka unaute aw, ne ding a na kikhop un kingak chiat un.
Na kikhop uh vaihawmna na thuakpihlouhna ding un, kuapeuh in agil akialleh a-inn lam ah ne masa hen. Huan thudang zaw ka hong pai chiang in ka bawllem ding hi.
